notes: EN to Traditional Chinese L0 corpus. Includes committed screenshot text plus deidentified scenario lines covering subtitles, game dialogue, UI, incomplete text, terminology, OCR noise, negation, and mixed-language content.

cases.sourceText: You seem rather dispirited, Minato-san.
cases.referenceTranslation: 湊小姐，妳看起來相當消沉。

cases.sourceText: Marina-san, are you okay?
cases.referenceTranslation: 瑪莉娜小姐，妳還好嗎？

cases.sourceText: We can't stay here much longer.
cases.referenceTranslation: 我們不能再在這裡待太久。

cases.sourceText: If we turn back now, everything was for nothing.
cases.referenceTranslation: 如果現在回頭，一切就都白費了。

cases.sourceText: Don't open that door—
cases.referenceTranslation: 別打開那扇門——

cases.sourceText: The northern gate... it's already—
cases.referenceTranslation: 北門……它已經——

cases.sourceText: No, that's not what I meant.
cases.referenceTranslation: 不，我不是那個意思。

cases.sourceText: I never said he stole the key.
cases.referenceTranslation: 我從沒說過是他偷了鑰匙。

cases.sourceText: Press E to interact.
cases.referenceTranslation: 按 E 互動。

cases.sourceText: Retry connection
cases.referenceTranslation: 重試連線

cases.sourceText: Loading... Do not close the application.
cases.referenceTranslation: 載入中……請勿關閉應用程式。

cases.sourceText: Are you sure you want to overwrite Save 03?
cases.referenceTranslation: 確定要覆寫存檔 03 嗎？

cases.sourceText: Hold Shift while dragging to snap to grid.
cases.referenceTranslation: 拖曳時按住 Shift，即可對齊格線。

cases.sourceText: Item cannot be used during combat.
cases.referenceTranslation: 戰鬥期間無法使用此物品。

cases.sourceText: Quest updated: Find the old observatory.
cases.referenceTranslation: 任務已更新：尋找舊天文台。

cases.sourceText: The server will restart in 5 minutes.
cases.referenceTranslation: 伺服器將在 5 分鐘後重新啟動。

cases.sourceText: Dr. Vale said the Aster core is unstable.
cases.referenceTranslation: 維爾博士說 Aster 核心不穩定。

cases.sourceText: HP +20 / Cooldown -10%
cases.referenceTranslation: 生命值 +20／冷卻時間 -10%

cases.sourceText: New message from Yuna (2)
cases.referenceTranslation: 來自 Yuna 的新訊息（2）

cases.sourceText: C0nnection lost. Retrying...
cases.referenceTranslation: 連線中斷。正在重試……
